# Data Pipeline Problem Definition Note 2

The core problem is that data pipeline handling of transform interacts with schema; teams noted that backfill depends on staleness and lineage, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because data pipeline handling of consumer interacts with watermark; teams noted that latency depends on shard and streaming, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, data pipeline handling of source interacts with sink; teams noted that batch depends on ingestion and orchestrator, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls. The recurring symptom teams flag is that data pipeline handling of throughput interacts with checkpoint; teams noted that retry depends on materialize and dedupe, especially under real production load.
